This skill should be used when the user needs to operate midas Gen software
through its API for structural modeling, analysis, and result extraction.
Covers creating models (nodes, elements, materials, sections, thickness),
applying boundary conditions (supports, rigid links, releases, springs),
defining loads (self-weight, node loads, beam loads, floor loads, temperature,
response spectrum), running analysis (static, eigenvalue, buckling, nonlinear),
and extracting results (displacements, forces, reactions, stresses).
Also handles connection detection, MAPI-KEY auto-read from registry, and
retrieving selected nodes/elements from Gen. Triggers on requests like
"midas建模", "midas Gen API", "建立材料", "建立截面", "生成节点", "建立单元",

"create beam midas", "apply load midas", "run analysis midas", "extract results midas", etc.
